name: Omarchy Qalculator
author: icyleaf
description: Raycast-style quick calculator overlay: type an expression, get the answer live, press Enter to copy.

schema.label: Input box position
schema.description: Where the input box sits: top and bottom hold a margin from the screen edge, center pins the input to the screen centre, window centres the whole card. The history and help lists fill the opposite side.

schema.label: Edge margin (%)
schema.description: Clear margin from the screen edge for the top and bottom positions, as a percentage of the screen height. Ignored by center and window.
